name: @usm/asset-ingest-spike
description: Plan 04 item 0: turns raw player recordings into validated, hashed, uploaded sound-manifest/sonicIdentity entries for band-jam.

scripts.test-ingest: npm run gen-test-intake && node src/ingest.mjs --session intake/_test-session-violin/session.json --manifest-out out/test-sound-manifest.json --identities-file out/test-sonic-identities.json && node src/ingest.mjs --session intake/_test-session-mandolin/session.json --manifest-out out/test-sound-manifest.json --identities-file out/test-sonic-identities.json && node src/ingest.mjs --session intake/_test-session-stereo/session.json --manifest-out out/test-sound-manifest.json --identities-file out/test-sonic-identities.json
scripts.all: npm run test-ingest && npm run verify-stereo
